meta_description: JMH Landscape and Maintenance in Sheffield. Expert garden design, landscaping, and regular maintenance. Local team, free quotes. Call 07840 073411.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations, we design and build outdoor spaces you'll love year-round.
services_heading: Complete Landscaping & Garden Maintenance Across Sheffield
services_subhead: Whether you need a one-off tidy-up or a full garden redesign, we handle every job with the same attention to detail.

services.title: Garden Design & Build
services.desc: Bespoke landscape designs tailored to your space and budget. We handle everything from initial concept through to planting and hardscaping.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly upkeep keeps your garden looking its best. Grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal care included.

services.title: Paving & Patios
services.desc: Professional laying of block paving, natural stone, and timber decking. Durable finishes that transform your outdoor entertaining space.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Safe, expert pruning and shaping of hedges and trees. We remove dead wood and improve shape whilst maintaining plant health.

services.title: Clearance & Removal
services.desc: Overgrown garden? We clear undergrowth, remove unwanted plants and rubble, and prepare the ground for new planting or hard landscaping.

services.title: Fencing & Boundaries
services.desc: New fence installation and repairs in wood, metal, or composite. We measure, install, and ensure your boundaries are secure and attractive.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own—honest work, fair prices, always.
about_para_1: JMH Landscape and Maintenance was founded in Sheffield with a simple belief: that every garden deserves care and attention to detail. Over 12 years, we've transformed more than 200 gardens across Sheffield and surrounding areas, building a reputation for reliable, friendly service and genuine craftsmanship. Whether you need a one-off overhaul or ongoing weekly maintenance, we approach every project with the same commitment to quality.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what you want and deliver without surprises. We're local, we're straightforward, and we turn up when we say we will. From small suburban gardens to larger landscaping projects, we have the experience and team to handle it all—and we're always happy to discuss your ideas over a free, no-pressure quote.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our back garden. We'd let it get completely out of hand, and JMH cleared it, designed a new layout, and laid a patio and new borders. Mike and the team were professional, tidy, and reasonably priced. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Been having JMH round for maintenance every fortnight for over a year now. They're reliable, friendly, and the garden always looks immaculate. No hassle, no faffing about—just a proper job done well.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Had new fencing and hedge work done in spring. Excellent attention to detail. The lads cleaned up properly afterwards too, which is rare. Definitely recommend them. Will be getting them back for more work.
reviews.author: Robert K.
